predicted_csat.label: Predicted CSAT
predicted_csat.detail: Inferred from opening/closing sentiment, whether the issue was resolved, and the effort the customer had to exert. Not a surveyed score.

handoff_rate.label: Handoff / escalation rate
handoff_rate.detail: Share of conversations the agent could not close at first contact and had to hand to a back-office/ops team.

avg_csat.label: Average CSAT
avg_csat.detail: Mean predicted CSAT across all audited conversations.

accuracy_completeness.label: Accuracy & completeness
accuracy_completeness.detail: Correct information given and order/booking lookups actually used.

empathy_tone.label: Empathy & tone
empathy_tone.detail: Acknowledgement of frustration and courteous, human language.

resolution_ownership.label: Resolution ownership
resolution_ownership.detail: Whether the agent drove to a concrete next step versus deflecting to another team. In this sample it is the cleanest separator of CSAT.

proactivity.label: Proactivity
proactivity.detail: Anticipated follow-up needs, added notes, offered extra help.

repeat_contact_signal.label: Repeat-contact signal
repeat_contact_signal.detail: True when the customer explicitly references a prior unresolved incident about the same issue.

churn_risk.label: Churn risk
churn_risk.formula: High if Cancelled/Refunded OR (CSAT ≤ 2 AND ends Frustrated/Angry); Medium if escalated & pending; else Low
churn_risk.detail: Derived from resolution outcome, closing sentiment and predicted CSAT — recomputed in the frontend from the conversation row.

journey_gaps.label: Journey gaps
journey_gaps.detail: Process, data or visibility gaps evident in the conversation — the operational-improvement backlog.
